395.text: His hands clawing at mine in a desperate attempt to break free. With a final heave, I pushed him out from underneath.

396.speaker: Narrator
396.text: In an instant, as gunfire tore through the air, and he crumpled to the ground, dead.

397.speaker: Narrator
397.text: With all eyes on Adarfo, I had a clear path to get away.

404.speaker: Narrator
404.text: As he tried to scramble to his feet, gunfire tore through the air, and he crumpled to the ground, dead.

406.speaker: Narrator
406.text: As I continued moving, the bookshelves kept me concealed, and before I knew it, I reached the spiral staircase.

410.speaker: Narrator
410.text: Adarfo followed my lead, and we managed to slip away. Before long, we were just a few feet away from the staircase.

411.speaker: Player_Romus
411.text: "We should double back. Without any cover, we'd be sitting ducks."

412.speaker: Narrator
412.text: I hesitated, realizing that any movement upward would surely leave us dangerously exposed.

413.speaker: Narrator
413.text: I hesitated, realizing that any movement upward would surely leave us dangerously exposed.

414.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
414.text: "Do what you like, but I'm not staying here a minute longer than I have to."

415.speaker: Narrator
415.text: Adarfo hurried up the stairs. Shots were fired at him, however, I didn't wait to see if managed to evade.

416.speaker: Player_Romus
416.text: "We need to proceed with caution. Who knows what's waiting for us if we make a run for it."

419.speaker: Narrator
419.text: I ducked and weaved my way through the bookstack. Doing so kept us concealed, and before long, we'd reached the spiral staircase.

421.speaker: Narrator
421.text: I ignored his sarcasm as we dashed for the staircase.

422.speaker: Narrator
422.text: However, we were soon spotted, and a guard unleashed a volley of shots in our direction.

423.speaker: Narrator
423.text: He missed. We didn't stop until we'd reached the stairs.

431.speaker: Narrator
431.text: He missed. We didn't stop until we'd reached the vault door. With the combination clicked into place, Adarfo and I entered.

435.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
435.text: "This was a mistake. I should've known better than to trust a monarch."

436.speaker: Narrator
436.text: I sank into a chair, waiting for the upheaval outside to end, while Adarfo paced about. Minutes felt like hours.

437.speaker: Player_Romus
437.text: "We’re still alive. That's more than you can say for your stupid movement."

438.speaker: Player_Romus
438.text: "Don’t mistake our situation for a failure. We’ll find a way to come out on top."

439.speaker: Player_Romus
439.text: "We may die, but the revolution never will."

440.speaker: Player_Romus
440.text: "Why don’t you keep complaining? Surely, that’ll solve everything."

441.speaker: Narrator
441.text: Adarfo abruptly slammed his hand against a shelf.

442.speaker: Narrator
442.text: Before I realized what was happening, Adarfo threw me against the floor and had me by the throat. I struggled to fight back, but his grip was unrelenting.

443.speaker: Narrator
443.text: Everything began to turn black. But it was at that moment that I heard the doors to the vault click open, followed by a loud commotion.

444.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
444.text: "The only thing we’re coming out of is this vault, when they decide it’s time to drag us out."

445.speaker: Narrator
445.text: When I came to, my stomach sank as I found myself looking up at Titus, flanked by several guards holding rifles. Adarfo lay nearby, not moving.

446.speaker: Narrator
446.text: And that's exactly what happened. As if on cue, we heard the gunfire subside and the sound of the door unlocking.

450.speaker: Narrator
450.text: Without warning, Adarfo charged toward our guests, screaming and waving his fists, before he was gunned down.

451.speaker: Narrator
451.text: It took a moment for my hearing to recover and make out what Titus was saying.

453.speaker: Titus Gordion
453.text: "Step out of the vault and follow me, Your Majesty."

454.speaker: Narrator
454.text: I rushed upward, the dizzying speed of my ascent distorted the frenzy below as Adarfo and I escaped the library’s violent interior.

455.speaker: Narrator
455.text: The cool night air greeted us as we spilled out from the rooftop exit and hurried to the fire escape leading down to the alley.

461.speaker: Player_Romus
461.text: "No. I'm not about to put myself at the mercy of an angry mob or risk plummeting to my death. I'm going back inside."

462.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
462.text: "Yes, it does seem like the best chance to avoid detection."

466.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
466.text: Go back inside to face the consequences of your choices.

467.speaker: Narrator
467.text: I turned around and went back inside.

468.speaker: Player_Romus
468.text: "There's no honor in running away. I'll be perceived as a coward. I have to go back and face the consequences of my actions head-on."

472.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
472.text: "Then you're a fool. There's only possible way that will turn out. And I'm not about to let that happen to me."

473.speaker: Narrator
473.text: Without a second thought, Adarfo gave himself a running start before leaping to the other rooftop. He took one last look at me before vanishing.

474.speaker: Narrator
474.text: I, on the other hand, turned back around and went inside. I then made my way down the stairs until I emerged back into the main hall.

476.speaker: Narrator
476.text: Without a second thought, Adarfo gave himself a running start before leaping to the other rooftop.

477.speaker: Narrator
477.text: He looked back and nodded his farewell before taking off, vanishing without a trace.

478.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
478.text: "If you want to take the fire escape, be my guest. But I'll stick to where it's actually harder to get caught."

513.text: Then, to my horror, several Wruhec's Guardians, rifles aimed in my direction, surrounded me.

514.speaker: Narrator
514.text: Then, to my horror, several Golden Guardsmen, rifles aimed in my direction, surrounded me.

518.speaker: Narrator
518.text: My eyes were then drawn to a nearby dead insurgent, still clutching his assault rifle.

526.speaker: Narrator
526.text: But my aim was off, and the shot missed. The Guardians turned and raised their weapons in response.

527.speaker: Narrator
527.text: But my aim was off, and the shot missed. The Golden Guardsmen turned and raised their weapons in response.

534.speaker: Narrator
534.text: The crack of gunfire rang out as I squeezed the trigger, and one of the Guardians dropped.

535.speaker: Narrator

542.speaker: Narrator
542.text: The second Guardian barely had time to react, scrambling to reposition, but the rebels finished him off in a flurry of shots.

596.text: And just when escape felt within reach, both Guardians were gunned down right before my eyes.

600.text: And just when escape felt within reach, Adarfo's freedom fighters were gunned down right before my eyes.

605.speaker: Narrator
605.text: My stomach sank when Titus, flanked by Captain Castellanus and his Wruhec's Guardians, stepped inside.

610.speaker: Narrator
610.text: His words were at the ancient Wruhecist for, "The Lord has guided us and delivered."

620.speaker: Narrator
620.text: I looked around for Vina and my mother. Neither were to be seen.

624.speaker: Narrator
624.text: I looked around for my mother. I couldn't see her anywhere.

625.speaker: Narrator
625.text: Emerging out into the main atrium, I saw a scene of pandemonium. Some of the invitees had taken up arms and were firing blindly at the attackers; others cowered behind library shelves.

633.speaker: Narrator
633.text: One of Titus' men was pointing a gun at Pabel, demanding he tell him what he knew of my plan.

634.speaker: Narrator
634.text: One of the House forces was pointing a gun at Pabel, demanding he tell him what he knew of my plan.

639.speaker: Narrator
639.text: As I was escorted out, I overheard the guards murmuring about my betrayal of the kingdom. Lucita approached.
639.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Target_StrikeHouseAzaro"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_ViolentAction_Deploy_AdarfosRevolutionaries"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true)

642.speaker: Narrator
642.text: The action froze. Everyone in the library stopped and stared at me.

646.speaker: Narrator
646.text: The guardsmen and the revolutionaries ignored me. The firefight continued.

648.speaker: Player_Romus
648.text: "I SAID, CEASE FIRE IMMEDIATELY! THE KING COMMANDS YOU!"

649.speaker: Narrator
649.text: Before I could finish the words, something heavy hit the back of my head. I lost consciousness.

650.speaker: Narrator
650.text: I don't know how much time passed before Titus nudged me awake.

653.speaker: Narrator
653.text: As if on cue, we heard the gunfire subside and the sound of the door unlocking.

657.speaker: Hugo Toras
657.text: "You know what hunters say, my boy..."

658.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
658.text: "The mob is your problem. Not mine."
